Customer: Casey Customer

This scope describes proposed work; completion has not been recorded.

The scope is prepared with reference to IICRC S500/S520 restoration practices. Project-specific conditions and evidence are recorded below; no unsupported section citation or completion claim is made.

The home was built in 1985. Therefore, no lead or asbestos testing is required prior to the start of work.

Equipment sizing check (IICRC S500 initial air mover placement; IICRC LGR dehumidification factor chart), from technician-confirmed room inputs:
Basement: 600 SF floor × 8 ft ceiling = 4,800 cu ft, water class 3. Air movers for 500 SF of wet floor: 1 + 500 ÷ 70 to 1 + 500 ÷ 50, rounded up = 9 to 11. LGR dehumidification: 4,800 ÷ 40 = 120 pints/day (AHAM).
Stairs: mold only; not part of the drying check.
Recommended: 9 to 11 air movers and 120 pints/day of LGR dehumidification (the room total, rounded up; 2 units at 70 pints/day each).
Entered for this proposal: 2 air movers and 1 LGR dehumidifier rated 70 pints/day each.
Wet walls above 2 feet, wet ceilings and wall offsets over 18 inches add air movers and are not part of this floor-based range.
